title: .mcp.json auto-executes network-fetched npm package (npx -y ue-mcp) with version pin but no integrity lock
detail: Every agent session boots network-fetched npm code with no integrity lock; registry or author compromise yields arbitrary code execution on contributor machines.
recommended_fix: Pin via a committed package.json + lockfile (npm ci) or verify the tarball digest before exec; record the trust decision in docs/research-report.md.

title: Unauthenticated loopback MCP endpoint (127.0.0.1:8000) mitigated only by operator discipline, not technical controls
evidence:
- Both servers are **loopback-only / unauthenticated** — never expose the
  port, never run them on a shared machine, never forward.
- The loopback trust model assumes only local processes can reach
  127.0.0.1. A **same-host browser** (any page you visit) can also issue
  requests to `http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp` (origin confusion / DNS
  rebinding-style reads) — never keep the editor's MCP server running while
  browsing untrusted sites.
detail: No technical auth on the editor MCP endpoint; the acknowledged browser origin-confusion risk is mitigated only by operator discipline while agent workflows start the server routinely.
recommended_fix: Keep the server stopped by default and start it only for recorded MCP sessions; never add -ModelContextProtocolStartServer to headless gates; consider token auth or socket binding.
